name: spec-controller-workspace
description: Workspace root for spec-controller — the reconciliation CLI and its pure core library.

scripts.lint:publint: publint --pack pnpm packages/core && publint --pack pnpm packages/spec-controller
scripts.docs:current-state: bash -o pipefail -c 'files=$(git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard) && [ -n "$files" ] || { echo "git listed no file for Vale to read" >&2; exit 1; }; git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard | xargs -0 vale'
scripts.docs:code-file-in-comment: bash -o pipefail -c 'files=$(git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- "*.ts" "*.tsx" "*.js" "*.jsx" "*.yml" "*.yaml" ":!pnpm-lock.yaml") && [ -n "$files" ] || { echo "git listed no file for Vale to read" >&2; exit 1; }; git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- "*.ts" "*.tsx" "*.js" "*.jsx" "*.yml" "*.yaml" ":!pnpm-lock.yaml" | xargs -0 vale --config=.vale/comments.ini'
scripts.docs:references: bash -o pipefail -c 'git ls-files -z -- "*.md" "features/*.feature" | xargs -0 remark --no-config --no-stdout --frail --quiet --use ./scripts/remark-feature-prose.mjs --use remark-validate-links'
scripts.docs:readme-examples: bash -o pipefail -c 'kiira check --entry README.md --entry "packages/*/README.md" --reporter json | jq -er --argjson files "$(git ls-files README.md "packages/*/README.md" | wc -l)" "(.diagnostics[] | \"\(.markdownFile):\(.markdownRange.start.line):\(.markdownRange.start.character) \(.severity) \(.source) \(.code) \(.message)\"), if .stats.markdownFiles != \$files or .stats.checked == 0 or .stats.errors > 0 or .stats.ignored > 0 then error(\"read \(.stats.markdownFiles) of \(\$files) READMEs; \(.stats.checked) examples checked; \(.stats.errors) type errors; \(.stats.ignored) examples left unchecked by a fence flagged ignore or validate=none\") else \"\(.stats.checked) examples in \(.stats.markdownFiles) READMEs type-check\" end"'
